# NexaHubTech crawler policy.
# Generated by scripts/generate-discovery.ts from src/lib/discovery/ — edit there.
#
# Every page renders in the browser, so a crawler that does not run JavaScript
# should read the markdown versions instead:
#   https://www.nexahubtech.company/llms.txt        index of every page, as markdown
#   https://www.nexahubtech.company/llms-full.txt   the whole site in one file
#   https://www.nexahubtech.company/schema.json     schema.org knowledge graph
#
# Hidden pages are kept out of search with a noindex tag, not a Disallow here:
# a disallowed URL can still be indexed from a link elsewhere, because the
# crawler is never allowed to fetch the page and see the instruction.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /_serverFn/
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes

# AI search engines — fetch pages to cite them in answers
# OAI-SearchBot (OpenAI), Claude-SearchBot (Anthropic), PerplexityBot (Perplexity), DuckAssistBot (DuckDuckGo), Applebot (Apple)
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: DuckAssistBot
User-agent: Applebot
Allow: /
Disallow: /_serverFn/

# AI assistants — fetch a page because a person asked about it
# ChatGPT-User (OpenAI), Claude-User (Anthropic), Perplexity-User (Perplexity), MistralAI-User (Mistral), Meta-ExternalFetcher (Meta)
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: Perplexity-User
User-agent: MistralAI-User
User-agent: Meta-ExternalFetcher
Allow: /
Disallow: /_serverFn/

# AI model training
# GPTBot (OpenAI), ClaudeBot (Anthropic), Google-Extended (Google), Applebot-Extended (Apple), Meta-ExternalAgent (Meta), Amazonbot (Amazon), CCBot (Common Crawl)
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: ClaudeBot
